title: [v0.4.26] Runners: isolate parallel PR checks safely
author: mcpdev80
body:
## Binding dependency correction — 2026-10-15

The implementation order is: #892 → #893 planning/execution interface → #896 isolated runner implementation → #893 final runtime/evidence integration and acceptance. #896 does not depend on completion or merge of all of #893.

PR #930 at `d56737bd147e54733c280383fa86ad2abccc7b33` is the current interface reference, not a qualified or merged dependency. Inspect its latest head and agree the concrete interface before editing. Do not execute privileged untrusted code or claim missing gates as successful.

- #893 owns `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, PR planning/execution orchestration, authenticated gate-evidence consumption and `PR Selected Checks`.
- #896 owns dedicated runner-isolation helpers and tests: per-run Target/volume/port/state isolation, trust boundaries, cleanup and capacity. Deliver a separate small PR against develop; do not copy #930 wholesale or edit its owned files in parallel.
- If an interface change is needed, agree it first and sequence the shared-file integration through the #893 owner. Exact-commit interface inspection does not authorize unreviewed production activation.
- Qualify #896 with focused isolation fixtures and the necessary two small isolated pilot lanes; then integrate its implementation and let #893 consume it. #893 remains open until authenticated runtime evidence and its Backup/Restore pilot pass.
- Required review/check protection in #895 follows a qualified #893 status check. Product implementation still requires the qualified #890–#893/#895/#896 foundation.
- One assigned task per session; stop after its handoff. No full pre-release, merge, tag or publication is authorized by this correction.

---

Parent/Epic: #888 · Release: #873 · Paket 4

**Ergebnis:** Unabhängige PR-Lanes teilen weder veränderlichen Runtime-State noch Berechtigungen.

**Dependencies:** #892 and the agreed #893 interface from PR #930; full #893 completion/merge is NOT a start prerequisite.

**Akzeptanz**

- [ ] Docker/Podman innerhalb tatsächlicher Slots parallel; keine fremden PRs/Kandidaten abbrechen.
- [ ] Eigene Targets/Volumes/Ports und zuverlässiger Cleanup; kein geteilter Provider-/Secret-/Recovery-State.
- [ ] Forks bekommen weder Secrets noch privilegierte Self-hosted-Runner; notwendige vertrauenswürdige Abnahme bleibt sichtbar offen.
- [ ] Caches nur für passende unveränderliche Buildinputs; kein Cache als Evidence.

**Prüfung:** Konfiguration und Sicherheits-/Isolation-Fixtures prüfen; zwei nötige kleine isolierte Pilot-Lanes samt Cleanup statt zusätzlicher Vollmatrix.

**Arbeitsweise:** eigener kleiner Branch/PR gegen develop; bei unabhängig reviewbaren Teilergebnissen weiter schneiden. Owner bei Übernahme setzen; aktuelle Regeln/Remote-Stände lesen, fremde Commits erhalten.

**Grenze:** Umsetzung erst ab v0.4.26 nach qualifiziertem v0.4.25-Abschluss/Promotion. Aktive #881-Workflows/Evidence unverändert. Keine Autorisierung für vollständigen Pre-Release, Merge, Tag oder Veröffentlichung. Konservative V1/Freigabegrenzen aus #888 gelten. Parent/Dependencies sind Textverweise; native GitHub-Hierarchie noch zu setzen.
